title: Module-folder tasks are not found unless someone reads that module
description: Owner (2026-10-26): a task filed into a module's tasks folder (e.g. /framework/ai/AISession/tasks/) is only seen by someone reading that module or the filing session's page; he doubts it is properly indexed, and finding it later takes someone a minute. Check that every task lands in an index the site and agents read (the ai index / task feeds), and add one open-tasks view across all modules (owner, state, age) so nothing waits unseen. Start by verifying the tasks filed today are in that index.
